verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments API platform, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a CLI. The documented developer surfaces are REST APIs, the kushki.js library, e-commerce plugins, Smartlink, and an llms.txt docs index. These are adjacent integration tools, not a command-line interface, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
